before.limitedReason: ٱلْفَضْلِ is a rootful noun with root ف ض ل. The audit found 9 safe related forms, but did not establish four additional high-value contrasts from canonical evidence, approved project meanings and aligned morphology without an unverified claim. The family is blocked for genuine linguistic ambiguity rather than accepted as limited; further lexicon-led authoring is required.
